summary: Uses a Kinect v1 sensor to create SOP geometry from depth/skeleton data for legacy Kinect-based installations.

key_params.name: hwversion
key_params.note: Hardware version; official SOP page supports Kinect v1.

common_gotchas: This SOP page is for Kinect v1; do not assume Kinect Azure behavior.
`full` and `seated` are skeleton menu values, not standalone toggle parameters.
Near depth mode changes minimum depth and can affect depth-derived geometry assumptions.
key_concepts: Kinect SOP creates geometry from Kinect v1 sensor data.
`hwversion` on the SOP page only supports Kinect v1.
`sensor` chooses the Kinect sensor index and `skeleton` chooses skeleton output mode.
`neardepthmode` changes minimum depth behavior from standard range to near mode.
`normals` computes normals for the generated geometry.
